episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Upon leaving hell, Lucifer Morningstar retreats to Los Angeles for a more exciting life. When the murder of a friend connects him with LAPD detective Chloe Decker, Lucifer becomes intrigued with the idea of punishing criminals, sending the devil himself into a struggle between good and evil.

episodes.title: Lucifer, Stay. Good Devil.
episodes.summary: When a movie star's son is killed after being chased by the paparazzi, Chloe takes a deep look into the case with a little help from Lucifer.

episodes.title: The Would-Be Prince of Darkness
episodes.summary: When a 22-year-old future superstar quarterback wakes up to find a dead girl floating in his swimming pool, he turns to his friend, Lucifer, for help.

episodes.title: Manly Whatnots
episodes.summary: In an effort to get over his infatuation with Chloe, Lucifer decides that he must seduce her. Meanwhile the two team up on a missing girl case and Amenadiel confronts Maze about his concerns about Lucifer.

episodes.title: Sweet Kicks
episodes.summary: After a shooting occurs at a fashion show and a young woman is killed, Lucifer begs Chloe to get in on the case.

episodes.title: Favorite Son
episodes.summary: Lucifer bails on Chloe when he becomes bored with her investigation into a ruthless biker gang murder.

episodes.title: Wingman
episodes.summary: Chloe digs deeper into the Palmetto case, uncovering a lead that might finally expose the truth.

episodes.title: Et Tu, Doctor?
episodes.summary: When a therapist is murdered, Lucifer and Chloe enlist the help of Dr. Linda to look into possible suspects.

episodes.title: A Priest Walks Into a Bar
episodes.summary: A priest seeks out Lucifer's help when he suspects an underground drug operation has set up shop at a neighborhood youth center.

episodes.title: Pops
episodes.summary: Lucifer and Chloe are tasked with solving the murder of a prominent restaurateur. When they meet his son, they suspect he played a part in the death.

episodes.title: St. Lucifer
episodes.summary: When philanthropist Tim Dunlear is found dead, Lucifer explores his good side by becoming a benefactor for Tim's glitzy Los Angeles charity.

episodes.title: #TeamLucifer
episodes.summary: When a woman is found dead on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, the investigation leads Lucifer and team into the world of Satanists.

episodes.title: Take Me Back to Hell
episodes.summary: When Lucifer is framed for murder, he and Chloe must work together to clear his name and prove the identity of the true killer.

episodes.title: Everything's Coming Up Lucifer
episodes.summary: Lucifer is distracted by his mother's escape from hell as he and Chloe investigate the murder of a stand-in actress.

episodes.title: Liar, Liar, Slutty Dress on Fire
episodes.summary: When Lucifer's mother turns up at the scene of a grizzly murder pleading innocence, he is hesitant to believe her tale.

episodes.title: Sin-Eater
episodes.summary: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a gruesome murder after a video of the crime surfaces on social media.

episodes.title: Lady Parts
episodes.summary: Chloe and Lucifer are on the hunt for a killer after two young LA transplants are found poisoned.

episodes.title: Weaponizer
episodes.summary: Lucifer is excited to investigate the murder of his favorite action movie hero, Wesley Cabot.

episodes.title: Monster
episodes.summary: A guilty and self-destructive Lucifer clashes with Chloe during an investigation, leading her to team up with Dan instead.

episodes.title: My Little Monkey
episodes.summary: New evidence suggests that the man convicted of killing Chloe's father was actually framed.

episodes.title: Trip to Stabby Town
episodes.summary: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a string of violent stabbings revolving around a local yoga studio.

episodes.title: Homewrecker
episodes.summary: Lucifer must deal with the new owner of his building that wants to evict him and demolish the place.

episodes.title: Quid Pro Ho
episodes.summary: Charlotte is determined to get Lucifer to leave Earth by turning Chloe against him.

episodes.title: Stewardess Interruptus
episodes.summary: Lucifer and Chloe investigate the murder of two victims, who happen to be Lucifer's ex-flames.

episodes.title: Love Handles
episodes.summary: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a mysterious masked killer who is poisoning college students.

episodes.title: A Good Day to Die
episodes.summary: Lucifer must find the antidote to the Professor's poison, so he travels to hell to find the Professor's soul.

episodes.title: Candy Morningstar
episodes.summary: Lucifer distances himself from his family and the police department after Chloe's near death, but appears to help solve the murder of a rising guitarist.

episodes.title: Deceptive Little Parasite
episodes.summary: The pressure is on for Lucifer to control what he has never been able to control before - his emotions.

episodes.title: God Johnson
episodes.summary: The prime suspect in an insane asylum murder, who claims to be God, begins to pique Lucifer's interest as he believes that he could really be his father.

episodes.title: Sympathy for the Goddess
episodes.summary: Mom joins Chloe and Lucifer as they pursue the person who murdered the man possessing the last piece of the Flaming Sword.

episodes.title: The Good, the Bad and the Crispy
episodes.summary: Lucifer attempts to protect Charlotte from Chloe when she mistakenly burns a man to death in self-defense.

episodes.title: They're Back, Aren't They?
episodes.summary: Lucifer enlists Chloe's help to determine why he woke up in the desert with his wings on his back again, which could be related to an active crime scene.

episodes.title: The One with the Baby Carrot
episodes.summary: Lucifer and Chloe try to deal with their uneasy relationship; the true danger Sinnerman poses is revealed by Detective Pierce's past.

episodes.title: Mr. and Mrs. Mazikeen Smith
episodes.summary: Maze travels to Canada for a case in search of meaning in her life after speaking with Lucifer and Linda, but Chloe worries that Maze is being deceived.

episodes.title: What Would Lucifer Do?
episodes.summary: Lucifer and Chloe explore the world of high-end reform programs when a youth counselor's deceased body is discovered.

episodes.title: Welcome Back, Charlotte Richards
episodes.summary: Lucifer and Chloe contend against criminal defense attorney Charlotte Richards during their investigation into a murdered food chemist.

episodes.title: Vegas with Some Radish
episodes.summary: When Lucifer learns that his ex-wife has disappeared, he brings Ella with him to Las Vegas to find her.

episodes.title: Off the Record
episodes.summary: A reporter learns that Lucifer has been sleeping with Linda, who happens to be the reporter's estranged wife.

episodes.title: Chloe Does Lucifer
episodes.summary: Lucifer and Chloe begin to doubt their knowledge of social media when a connection is found between a celebrity dating app and a recent murder.

episodes.title: The Sinnerman
episodes.summary: Lucifer grows concerned when some of the people he's given favors to begin dying.

episodes.title: The Sin Bin
episodes.summary: While the Sinnerman is held in custody, Lucifer prepares to get his devil face back at any cost, until another victim's life shakes his confidence.

episodes.title: City of Angels?
episodes.summary: Back when Lucifer first arrived in Los Angeles, Amenadiel becomes the victim of a mugging and asks for Lucifer's assistance with the matter.

episodes.title: All About Her
episodes.summary: Lucifer helps Chloe solve a case involving a murdered surfer to get her to help him determine Lt. Pierce's motives after his real identity is revealed.

episodes.title: Til Death Do Us Part
episodes.summary: Pierce and Lucifer go undercover when a former ecstasy manufacturer, who became a chemistry teacher, is found dead in a suburb of Los Angeles.

episodes.title: My Brother's Keeper
episodes.summary: Ella asks for help from an unexpected ally to prove her brother's innocence when he becomes a main suspect in a case involving a diamond thief's murder.

episodes.title: High School Poppycock
episodes.summary: A deceased novelist has based her books on real people she met in her past and must sneak into a high school reunion to find her killer.

episodes.title: Infernal Guinea Pig
episodes.summary: Chloe places her life in potential danger in order to protect an innocent victim during a murder investigation.

episodes.title: Let Pinhead Sing!
episodes.summary: The team is forced to integrate themselves into the world of big-ticket stadium shows after the life of a superstar singer is threatened.

episodes.title: The Last Heartbreak
episodes.summary: While Chloe and Lucifer search for a serial killer who is targeting couples in love, Pierce stumbles upon a connection to a murder he solved in 1958.

episodes.title: Orange Is the New Maze
episodes.summary: Lucifer and Chloe integrate themselves into the world of bounty hunting when Maze is considered a prime suspect in a murder.

episodes.title: The Angel of San Bernardino
episodes.summary: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a murder which a witness claims a guardian angel saved her life, causing Lucifer to become paranoid about his own actions.

episodes.title: Anything Pierce Can Do I Can Do Better
episodes.summary: Lucifer tries distracting Chloe from anything related to Pierce while Lucifer and she investigate the murder of a prima ballerina.

episodes.title: All Hands on Decker
episodes.summary: Lucifer is forced to investigate a murder case with Dan that involves a dog show while Chloe takes some time off.

episodes.title: Quintessential Deckerstar
episodes.summary: Lucifer and Chloe realize they may be chasing the wrong suspect during a murder investigation.

episodes.title: A Devil of My Word
episodes.summary: Stunned by a recent death, Chloe, Lucifer and the rest of the team decide to join forces in order to find out who the killer is and take them down.

episodes.title: Boo Normal
episodes.summary: As Lucifer and the team investigate the murder of a child psychiatrist, Ella thinks about a big childhood secret that she's been hiding.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Time
episodes.summary: Lucifer's mom creates an alternate dimension, Lucifer now lives in a world where he not only has never met Chloe, but is granted the freedom of choice.

episodes.title: Everything's Okay
episodes.summary: While investigating a beekeeper's murder with Lucifer, Chloe insists that she's completely fine with his devilish revelation, thank you very much.

episodes.title: Somebody's Been Reading Dante's Inferno
episodes.summary: Chloe and Lucifer look into a murder on the set of a reality show. Father Kinley presses forward with a plan. Amenadiel reconsiders his idea of home.

episodes.title: O, Ye of Little Faith, Father
episodes.summary: An ex-gang member's murder may mask an even darker crime. Lucifer catches Chloe in a lie. Dan and Maze go rogue. Linda braces for looming motherhood.

episodes.title: All About Eve
episodes.summary: When a jewelry designer is murdered, Lucifer and Chloe strive to solve the case without each other's help. Also, Lucifer reconnects with an old flame.

episodes.title: Expire Erect
episodes.summary: After a collector of classic cars is killed, Lucifer and Chloe search for the culprit -- as well as some closure to their relationship.

episodes.title: Orgy Pants to Work
episodes.summary: While Lucifer and Chloe search for a connection between a murdered auditor and a nudist colony, Amenadiel plays host to an unexpected visitor.

episodes.title: Devil Is as Devil Does
episodes.summary: Eve takes a more active role in her main man's professional life. Meanwhile, Lucifer gets back to basics and Amenadiel fights for his family.

episodes.title: Super Bad Boyfriend
episodes.summary: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a teacher's murder. Meanwhile, Lucifer goes to extremes to convince Eve to dump him, and Amenadiel mentors a teen.

episodes.title: Save Lucifer
episodes.summary: Lucifer's so-called epiphany has Chloe worried, but it's his physical transformation that's really freaking her out. Also, Maze gives Eve a pep talk.

episodes.title: Who's da New King of Hell?
episodes.summary: With murderous demons on the loose in Los Angeles, it's up to Lucifer to reign in the chaos and protect the people he most cares about.

episodes.title: Really Sad Devil Guy
episodes.summary: Lucifer toys with a murder victim while Chloe and Maze investigate the death. Meanwhile, Amenadiel cleans up the club, and Linda mothers a genius.

episodes.title: Lucifer! Lucifer! Lucifer!
episodes.summary: After spending an eternity in hell, Lucifer returns to the land of the living — but there's something a little different about this handsome devil.

episodes.title: ¡Diablo!
episodes.summary: Lucifer — the real one this time — helps Chloe investigate a murder committed on the set of a TV show inspired by his own life.

episodes.title: It Never Ends Well for the Chicken
episodes.summary: The year is 1946. The world is black and white. And Lucifer is the star of his own noir detective story featuring familiar characters in new roles.

episodes.title: Detective Amenadiel
episodes.summary: Amenadiel helps Chloe investigate a nun's untimely demise. Meanwhile, Lucifer lends Dan a hand, and Linda reveals a painful part of her history.

episodes.title: BluBallz
episodes.summary: After a popular DJ is electrocuted on stage, Chloe searches for the killer while Lucifer tries to keep his jealousy over an ex-flame in check.

episodes.title: Our Mojo
episodes.summary: As a shocking side effect of his romance with Chloe throws Lucifer for a loop, the new couple pursues a murderer with a most unusual M.O.

episodes.title: Spoiler Alert
episodes.summary: Chloe learns a serial killer may have embellished his crimes. Amenadiel worries about his son's health. Pete opens up to Ella.

episodes.title: Family Dinner
episodes.summary: Chloe and Ella investigate a mini-golf murder. Lucifer, Michael, Amenadiel and Linda prepare for the holiest of family dinners.

episodes.title: Bloody Celestial Karaoke Jam
episodes.summary: It's a musical? Yep, it's a musical. Lucifer, Chloe and the gang sing and dance to a slew of popular tunes while investigating a referee's murder.

episodes.title: Resting Devil Face
episodes.summary: Lucifer's father — you know, God — decides to experience life as a regular human. Meanwhile, a boxer dies under mysterious circumstances.

episodes.title: Daniel Espinoza: Naked and Afraid
episodes.summary: A straightforward prisoner transport job turns into an increasingly dangerous, yet oddly invigorating, odyssey for Dan.

episodes.title: A Little Harmless Stalking
episodes.summary: Linda throws herself into a deeply personal mission. Maze unmasks a blast from the past. Amenadiel ponders a new job.

episodes.title: Nothing Lasts Forever
episodes.summary: Lucifer angles to be his father's successor. Ella makes a painful confession. Chloe investigates a murder at an aquarium.

episodes.title: Is This Really How It's Going to End?!
episodes.summary: Lucifer learns that not all of his siblings want him to land the big promotion. Also, Dan offers to set Ella up with an old friend.

episodes.title: A Chance at a Happy Ending
episodes.summary: The end is nigh! Lucifer, Chloe, Maze and Amenadiel prepare for battle with Michael and his not-so-angelic army of supporters.

episodes.title: Nothing Ever Changes Around Here
episodes.summary: Before Lucifer starts his new job, he and Chloe experience a magical night with a murderous end. Linda and Amenadiel host Maze and Eve for dinner.

episodes.title: Buckets of Baggage
episodes.summary: Desperate to be helpful, Lucifer assists an exasperated Carol investigate a drag queen's death. Ella and Chloe look into Carol's mysterious background.

episodes.title: Yabba Dabba Do Me
episodes.summary: Loony Lucifer and cartoon Chloe find themselves trapped in an animated loop. Amenadiel prepares for his new job. Dan returns to the city of angels.

episodes.title: Pin the Tail on the Daddy
episodes.summary: Lucifer reconnects with a few former flames in hopes of disproving Rory's claim. Dan tries to find someone — anyone — who can actually see him.

episodes.title: The Murder of Lucifer Morningstar
episodes.summary: Not believing that he could have abandoned his future daughter, Lucifer sets out to prove an alternate theory: He must have been murdered.

episodes.title: A Lot Dirtier Than That
episodes.summary: Wanting to do well on his first day with the LAPD, Amenadiel crosses paths with a racist detective from his past. Also, Lucifer tries to bond with Rory.

episodes.title: My Best Fiend's Wedding
episodes.summary: Just as Eve and Maze's wedding day arrives, Eve's ex, Adam — yes, that Adam — shows up hoping to reconcile. Later, Ella delivers some distressing news.

episodes.title: Save the Devil, Save the World
episodes.summary: Lucifer says he's finally ready to be God, but his non-functioning wings would tend to disagree. Linda reluctantly shares the first draft of her book.

episodes.title: Goodbye, Lucifer
episodes.summary: Lucifer tries to enjoy what may be his last day on Earth, Dan's killer escapes from prison, and Chloe drops a serious bombshell.

episodes.title: Partners 'Til the End
episodes.summary: Desperate to rescue Rory, Lucifer and Chloe confront her kidnapper with guns and wings blazing. Lucifer finally comes to terms with his purpose.
